context_branches.branch_paraphrase: The locked listing replaces descriptive name/type with [Locked]. Look requests a password before displaying Summary. The historic claim that WordPerfect Corporation has no forgotten-password unlock method is preserved as source prose, not modern security guidance.

context_branches.topic: Parallel type alternatives and generated native boundaries
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Parallel type2 turns columns off and on at the end of the last column. Type3 adds Block Protect around Column On/Off so a short camera/narration pair stays together across soft page breaks. Long narration may instead need type2. Guided Hard Page after column2 produces Block Protect Off, Column Off, a return for spacing, then Block Protect On and Column On for the next pair. Both alternative type semantics and exact generated owners remain documentary claims pending native/runtime evidence.
